q1.q: When does the admission process start?
q1.a: The admission process typically begins in December/January for the upcoming academic year. Please contact the school office for exact dates.

q2.q: What documents are required for admission?
q2.a: Required documents include: Birth Certificate, Transfer Certificate (TC) from previous school, Aadhar Card, Recent passport-size photographs, Previous year's report card/mark sheet, and Caste certificate (if applicable).

q3.q: What is the age criteria for admission?
q3.a: Age eligibility is calculated as on 31st March of the academic year. For Nursery/LKG: 3-4 years, UKG: 4-5 years, Class I: 5-6 years, and Class II onwards as per CBSE norms.

q4.q: Are admissions open to all students?
q4.a: Yes, admissions are open to all children irrespective of caste, creed, or religion, subject to eligibility criteria and seat availability.

president.title: A Beacon of Education
president.p2: It gives me immense pleasure to welcome you to St. Mary's Public School, Khopoli. Our vision has always been to create an institution that stands as a beacon of educational excellence.
president.p3: Education is not merely about academic achievement; it is about building character, instilling values, and preparing children for the future with confidence and compassion.
president.p4: I am confident that with the support of parents, teachers, and management, our students will continue to excel in all aspects of life.

vp.title: Empowering our children to become responsible citizens
vp.p1: In this rapidly changing world, quality education is the cornerstone of growth, and sustenance. It serves as the compass that guides one to navigate the complexities and challenges of modern life. True education extends beyond the walls of a classroom and goes beyond mere acquisition of facts and knowledge; it forms of wisdom, resilience, integrity, and compassion. Such an education empowers our children to become responsible citizens, thoughtful leaders, and compassionate servants of society.
vp.p2: Through this noble journey of learning, let us remain committed to nurturing not only intellectual excellence but also strong moral and spiritual values. May this institute inspire every student to pursue truth with humility, face challenges with courage, and use their God-given talents for the well-being of others.
vp.p3: I extend my heartfelt blessings and best wishes to all our students, teachers, parents, and families. May your educational journey always be filled with the joy of discovery, the perseverance to overcome every challenge, and the grace of Almighty God to grow continually in knowledge, wisdom, faith, and character.

principal.p2: It is my privilege to welcome you to St. Mary's Public School, where we believe that every child is unique and deserves the best education possible. principal.p4: I invite you to explore our programs and discover the many opportunities we offer. We look forward to welcoming you to our school community.

philosophy.title: Education with Values
philosophy.textHtml:
We at St. Mary's Public School, Khopoli try to teach these attributes and values to our children through various activities. We believe that by learning and following these values, we can bring a radical change in our society.

St. Mary's Public School is dedicated to offering education that emphasizes not only academic skills but also moral values, discipline, and extracurricular activities. The institution caters to students from pre-primary to primary level following a curriculum that prepares them for the challenges of higher education and life beyond school.

journey.title: Our Journey
journey.p1Html: St. Mary's Public School, Khopoli is the vision of H.G. Geevarghese Mar Coorilos, the President of The Malankara Orthodox Church Council of Bombay (MOCCB). Envisioned as the first step towards both diversifying the curriculums of, and also providing a complete education from KG to PG to the region of Khopoli; and to ultimately be the beacon of educational excellence which would help in the growth and upliftment for the entire region.
journey.p2Html: This land was bought back in 2018 - at a time when the industrial area of Khopoli predominantly had educational institutes following the curriculum of the State Board of Maharashtra (SSC). And its humble beginning on 12th June, 2019 simply marks the turning of this wonderful dream into a reality.
journey.p3: St. Mary's Khopoli thrives under the able guidance of its management, unceasing support of the parents and skillful teaching and non-teaching staff. As an institution, we work harder each day to fulfill this vision entrusted to us by our visionary leader, striving to become a better version of ourselves; while simultaneously encouraging our students to do the same - to follow their dreams and improving themselves with each day.

vm.title: Vision & Mission
vm.subtitle: Guided by strong values and a passion for excellence, we nurture confident learners with knowledge, compassion, leadership and integrity.
vm.visionText: To be a beacon of excellence in education — where young minds are nurtured to shine with knowledge, moulded through holistic learning rooted in values, guided by faith, and driven by purpose—ready to lead, serve, and shape a better world.
vm.mission1: To create an inclusive, vibrant & safe learning environment—where each one is valued, every voice is heard, and every potential is nurtured.
vm.mission2: By instilling compassion, discipline, and excellence in our students, we empower them to grow academically, morally, emotionally, socially, and spiritually.
vm.mission3: By fostering curiosity, critical thinking, creativity, innovation and leadership, we aim at guiding them to become lifelong learners, respectful of diversity, and committed to serving a greater good.
vm.mission4: By partnering with the parents and the community, we intend to ensure the all-round growth of their personality and character.

approach.title: Activity-Based Learning
approach.subtitle: We focus on experiential learning through workshops, activities and practical exposure that strengthen creativity and critical thinking.
